d: Bihar men baba bageshvar (pandit dhirendr krishn shastri) ke 13 se 16 disanbar tak hone vale 4 divsiy baksar daure se pahle hi sube ka siyasi para charh gaya hai. madhy pradesh ke chhatarpur sthit bageshvar dham jakar baba ka aashirvad lene ke bad bihar ke shiksha mantri mithilesh tivari ne virodhiyon ko khuli chunauti di. mantri mithilesh tivari ne kaha ki "baba ko bihar aane se rokne ki takat kisi men nahin hai aur ab bihar men 'sanatan bhajpa' ki sarkar hai." mantriji ke is bayan par RJD aur kangres ne jordar palatvar kiya hai. RJD pravakta ejaj ahmad ne aarop lagaya ki shiksha mantri…
